title: WoDX Actions
description: World of Darkness Expanded: non-combat actions with a menu for every line (Kindred hunting, feeding, blood, frenzy, Road, torpor, diablerie; ghouls, mortals, hunters, Garou, mages, changelings, wraiths, spirits, creatures, demons, mummies, Exalted), powers as timed effects. Private use only; not for distribution or sale. Feeding reads what is in the vessel's blood: drink, drugs or a blood-borne disease, which a vampire can spot, resist or come to carry (V20 pp. 295, 301-302).

requires.reason: Conditions, timed effects, the approval queue and search boxes.

recommends.reason: Shares the health-track rules; damage goes through it when both are on.
